_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S5 Joovy). Sourced 2026-07-05. Represents the current Joovy Caboose RS Premium; Clek lists 'Caboose S/RS'. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Joovy Caboose RS / Caboose S (Caboose RS Premium)

clekListed.clekRow: Joovy Caboose S/RS — Universal Car Seat Adapter / Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: front seat from ~3 mo, or newborn with the bassinet + car seat adapter; rear standing platform to 44 in

safety.standards: US federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833 (mandatory for US strollers); Clek confirms all listed strollers were tested to the applicable ASTM standards for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: Magnetic 5-point harness buckles; leatherette handlebar; oversized UPF 50 canopy. Joovy does not publish a per-model JPMA certification.

specs.strollerType: premium sit-and-stand tandem double (full-size reclining front seat + bench + stand-on platform that also accepts a bassinet; optional rear seat sold separately)
specs.recline: reclining full-size front seat; stand-on platform converts to accept a bassinet

notes: Current premium Caboose RS/S sit-and-stand. Retailer dimension labels are scrambled at source (reported '24.1L x 43.5W x 46.1H' assembled / '24.1L x 50.4W x 13.4H' folded); re-mapped here to sensible L×W×H (43.5×24.1×46.1 open, 50.4×24.1×13.4 folded) with this note. Max 55 lb per seat, 25 lb basket. Clek Liing attaches via Joovy's Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna Caboose RS/S click-in adapter (adapter-joovy-universal-mcn); a separate strap-style universal adapter (SKU 9125) also exists for the RS/S front position. DTC price $569.90.
